issue.title: [test_lag_member] doesn't take into account if DUT have ports with different speed

failure.body:
**Description**
Test `test_lag_member` fails when port members are added to newly created `PortChannel1` with below error:
```
E           RunAnsibleModuleFail: run module shell failed, Ansible Results =>
E           {
E               "changed": true,
E               "cmd": "config portchannel member add PortChannel1 Ethernet184",
E               "delta": "<IPV6>.608702",
E               "end": "2022-09-18 <IPV6>.547431",
E               "failed": true,
E               "invocation": {
E                   "module_args": {
E                       "_raw_params": "config portchannel member add PortChannel1 Ethernet184",
E                       "_uses_shell": true,
E                       "argv": null,
E                       "chdir": null,
E                       "creates": null,
E                       "executable": null,
E                       "removes": null,
E                       "stdin": null,
E                       "stdin_add_newline": true,
E                       "strip_empty_ends": true,
E                       "warn": true
E                   }
E               },
E               "msg": "non-zero return code",
E               "rc": 2,
E               "start": "2022-09-18 <IPV6>.938729",
E               "stderr": "Usage: config portchannel member add [OPTIONS] <portchannel_name> <port_name>\nTry \"config portchannel member add -h\" for help.\n\nError: Port speed of Ethernet184 is different than the other members of the portchannel PortChannel1",
E               "stderr_lines": [
E                   "Usage: config portchannel member add [OPTIONS] <portchannel_name> <port_name>",
E                   "Try \"config portchannel member add -h\" for help.",
E                   "",
E                   "Error: Port speed of Ethernet184 is different than the other members of the portchannel PortChannel1"
```

Test doesn't take into account if DUT have ports configured with different speed (for example 50g and 100g), and might eventually try to add ports with different speed modes to a single PortChannel, which will lead to above error.

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Deploy Sonic
2. Deploy `t0` topology
3. Run `pc/test_lag_member.py` on DUT which have ports configured with different speed

**Describe the results you received:**
TC fails with error:
`Error: Port speed of Ethernet184 is different than the other members of the portchannel PortChannel1`

**Describe the results you expected:**
TC Passed

### Description of PR

Summary:  Test `test_lag_member` fails when port members are added to newly created PortChannel1 with below error:
```

E               "start": "2022-09-18 <IPV6>.938729",
E               "stderr": "Usage: config portchannel member add [OPTIONS] <portchannel_name> <port_name>\nTry \"config portchannel member add -h\" for help.\n\nError: Port speed of Ethernet184 is different than the other members of the portchannel PortChannel1",
E               "stderr_lines": [
E                   "Usage: config portchannel member add [OPTIONS] <portchannel_name> <port_name>",
E                   "Try \"config portchannel member add -h\" for help.",
E                   "",
E                   "Error: Port speed of Ethernet184 is different than the other members of the portchannel PortChannel1"
```
Test doesn't take into account if DUT have ports configured with different speed and might eventually try to add ports with different speed modes to a single PortChannel, which will lead to above error.
In order to fix this issue, we might determine most common port speed, and add port members to PortChannel only with such speed. In case when number of ports with same speed is less than default number of lag members, use number of ports with same speed.

Fixes #6468
